domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains or URLs to check, e.g. apify.com, https://www.shopify.com/blog. Paths and www are stripped.

includeDomainAge.title: Domain age, expiry and registrar

maxRows.title: Max domains per run
maxRows.description: Cap on domains checked. Controls cost.
